dimension: Choose an optional display mode within the 3D view without exposing renderer implementation names on the primary customer surface.
scope: Only these three copy pairs and the parent-supplied existing explicit display choice were reviewed. Working camera code, default view/fit mathematics, rendered devices, existing Fit wording and the ongoing eff8341d Standards verdict are separate.
rulers: Current AGENTS/CONTEXT vocabulary and formal de_DE_formal register
Humanizer pattern removal only; functional UI guidance is allowed and the formal register is preserved

final_pairs.opposition_and_resolution: View options / Ansichtsoptionen is a plain disclosure label for display settings. The plural is a normal category heading, not a promise of extra unimplemented controls. It does not promote a renderer API as customer value.

Compatibility mode / Kompatibilitätsmodus names the existing optional display choice in context. It must remain beside the 3D-specific help; there it does not imply inverter/battery compatibility, engineering release, automatic repair or support for every device.

draft.en: Use this if the 3D view does not display correctly.
draft.de: Nutzen Sie diesen Modus, wenn die 3D-Ansicht nicht korrekt dargestellt wird.

final_pairs.opposition_and_resolution: The conditional help describes when the reader can try an actual control. It does not say the mode will resolve the problem. Nutzen Sie is natural formal German; the 3D-Ansicht compound is idiomatic. This necessary UI instruction is not marketing homework.

final_proposal.en: Use this if the 3D view does not display correctly.
final_proposal.de: Nutzen Sie diesen Modus, wenn die 3D-Ansicht nicht korrekt dargestellt wird.

implementation_contracts_to_check_at_fix: The disclosure belongs to the 3D display, and its checkbox help remains associated with the actual checkbox so compatibility cannot be confused with electrical suitability.
The optional checkbox selects the existing explicitly requested WebGL 2 display path. No automatic device-repair, universal-support or successful-render promise is introduced.
Selecting a display mode changes no roof geometry, energy result, original source, engineering status, project revision or saved-data fact.
Renderer diagnostics may remain inspectable in data-renderer; hiding API names from the primary label does not erase the underlying evidence.
The existing accessible control and its EN/DE per-script catalog must actually use these exact strings. This copy review does not establish native loading or visual acceptance.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Claims a successful repair that this optional existing renderer choice cannot guarantee.

rejected_alternatives.text: Works on all devices / Compatible with every browser
WebGPU / WebGL 2 as the primary mode labels
rejected_alternatives.reason: Implementation names do not explain the customer action; keep technical diagnostics in their inspectable detail surface.

handoff: All three final proposals are unchanged and ready for parent adoption. Record final source/catalog/native evidence separately. This feedback does not change the fixed eff8341d code review or accept the complete workbench goal.
